# DeepGym Contributor Assignment Agreement

Version 1.0

This agreement is between you and Abhishek Gahlot, the maintainer of DeepGym ("we" or "us"), and anyone we transfer it to under section 7. It covers everything you submit to the DeepGym repositories on GitHub.

1. **Definitions.** "Contribution" means any code, documentation, data or other material you submit to us for a DeepGym project, by pull request, patch, comment or otherwise, except material you clearly mark "Not a Contribution" when you submit it. "You" means the person signing, or the company or other organisation on whose behalf you sign.

2. **Assignment.** You assign to us all right, title and interest worldwide in the copyright and other intellectual property rights in your Contributions, including the right to sue for past, present and future infringement. Each Contribution becomes our property when you submit it. We may use, change, license, sell or otherwise deal with it on any terms, without paying or notifying you.

3. **Moral rights.** Where the law doesn't allow moral rights to be assigned, you waive them, and agree not to assert them, against us and anyone who gets rights from us.

4. **Fallback license.** If any part of the assignment in section 2 isn't effective where you live, you instead grant us an exclusive, perpetual, worldwide, irrevocable, royalty-free license, with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers, to do anything with that Contribution that its owner could do.

5. **Patent license.** You grant us, and everyone who receives software we distribute, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable license to make, have made, use, sell, offer to sell, import and otherwise transfer your Contributions. This covers only the patent claims you can license that your Contribution infringes on its own or when combined with the project you submitted it to.

6. **Your promises.** You can legally make this assignment. Each Contribution is your original work, or you named any part written by someone else, its license and where it came from when you submitted it. If your employer or anyone else has rights in what you create, they have allowed you to assign your Contributions on these terms, waived their rights, or signed this agreement themselves. You'll sign any further documents we reasonably ask for to record or enforce the assignment.

7. **Transfer.** We may assign or transfer this agreement, and the rights we receive under it, to any person or company, including one that acquires DeepGym or its assets, without your consent. It binds and benefits our successors and assigns.

8. **No obligation and no warranty.** We don't have to use any Contribution. Unless the law requires otherwise or you agree in writing, you provide your Contributions "as is", without warranties or conditions of any kind.

9. **Scope and signing.** You sign by following the instructions the CLA bot posts on your pull request. Once signed, this agreement covers all your Contributions to DeepGym, including those made before you signed.
